divergences: src/pho3nix_tuner/genome_schema.py: the sys.path insert of <repo>/src (and the now-unused sys/Path imports) is removed; the five alienclaw.genome.* imports become alienclaw_ga.genome.* and lose their E402 noqa. Codec behavior unchanged (tests/test_parity_in_tree.py: decode and encode byte-identical to in-tree).
src/pho3nix_tuner/fitness_adapter.py: the lazy FitnessReport import inside callback() is rewritten alienclaw.evolution.generation -> alienclaw_ga.evolution.generation. Nothing else changed.

src/pho3nix_tuner/run_ga.py: the sys.path insert of <repo>/src is removed; the insert of the package's parent (src/) is kept so `python src/pho3nix_tuner/run_ga.py` still resolves pho3nix_tuner. Four top-level imports and the lazy FitnessReport import are rewritten alienclaw.* -> alienclaw_ga.*; ruff re-sorted the import block (alienclaw_ga is a separate third-party group).

src/pho3nix_tuner/run_ga.py (staged fix): Step 2 loads entries with inspect_history._load_history instead of `raw if isinstance(raw, list) else raw.get('entries', raw.get('runs', []))`. In-tree, a {"history": [...]} dump passed the STOP gate (whose loader accepts entries/runs/history) and was then read back as [], so the GA ran on an empty reward model. Bare-list, entries and runs dumps behave as before.

src/pho3nix_tuner/reward_model.py (staged fix): RewardModel.from_file uses inspect_history._load_history (lazy import) for the same reason; the now-unused `import json` is removed. Asserted as the one declared difference in tests/test_parity_in_tree.py::test_declared_divergence_history_envelope.
src/pho3nix_tuner/__init__.py: __version__ 0.1.0 -> 0.0.0.dev0 (and the docstring's Version line) to match pyproject.toml.

README.md: rewritten for the staged package (layout, data gate and why it is closed, how to run with PYTHONPATH, lift requirements, fragilities); the gate conditions and execution-boundary content come from the in-tree README.

New files with no in-tree source: pyproject.toml, PROVENANCE.json, tests/conftest.py, tests/_synth.py (hand-built synthetic histories in Pho3nix's run-history row shape; no real rig data), tests/test_genome_schema.py, tests/test_bounds_agreement.py, tests/test_inspect_history.py, tests/test_stop_gate.py, tests/test_reward_model.py, tests/test_tiny_ga_run.py, tests/test_parity_in_tree.py, tests/test_no_alienclaw_imports.py. The in-tree package had no tests.
Not staged: pho3nix_tuner/data/ (gitignored imported rig history; never copied) and pho3nix_tuner/__pycache__/.
